issues.body: Must be complete before Session 1 per the TMG Pre-Season Checkpoint; verify before the first working meeting.

issues.body: Collect at the Aug 20 meeting; chase stragglers weekly. Hard backstop: all paperwork done by 2026-10-31.

issues.body: Treat like a real qualifier: confirm start/end times, whether judging is offered, travel, and any event-specific rules (they vary by event type).

issues.title: Paperwork: Main December event registration (date TBD)
issues.body: Register as soon as the organizer posts the date; confirm event type/organizer, times, travel, and requirements at the Final Checkpoint (Dec 8).

issues.body: Checkpoint 2 requirement after Session 8. Sequencing: innovation project rubric needed before Oct 6 (Session 10), robot design rubric before Oct 13 (Session 11), scoresheets in use from Oct 8 onward.

issues.title: Paperwork: Innovation Project Planning sheet (Engineering Notebook p29) — all boxes
issues.body: Dated boxes: Problem Statement by Aug 25 (Session 3, hard TMG deadline), Research by Sep 1 (Session 5), Solution Planning by Sep 8 (Session 6), Feedback by Sep 22 (Session 8), 'Summarize Your Project' before the event — final check Nov 5.

issues.title: Paperwork: Team Progress sheet (Engineering Notebook p8) — all three sections
issues.body: Start Here at Aug 20 (Session 2), Halfway There at Sep 8 (Session 6), Event Time at Oct 13 (Session 11); reviewed again in Session 12 and at wrap-up.

issues.body: Completed in Session 6; reusable for later missions.

issues.title: Paperwork: Robot Design Notes / mission notes (Engineering Notebook p30, photocopied per mi
issues.body: Ongoing every meeting from Session 1; judges want documented iteration evidence — this feeds the robot design explanation.

issues.title: Paperwork: Robot program backups to USB stick or online storage
issues.body: First full backup at Session 9; refresh after every change (programs downloaded to the controller cannot be pulled back for editing).

issues.title: Paperwork: Accommodations request to event organizer (if any member needs one)
issues.body: TMG says contact the organizer no later than Session 11; applies to both the scrimmage and the main event.

issues.title: Paperwork: Event packing checklist (Engineering Notebook p26)
issues.body: Written in Session 12; includes robot + labeled attachment bags, device/chargers, program-notes paper (one sheet per home area), spare batteries/power pack, microSD, prototype/visuals/scripts. Refreshed Nov 5 for the scrimmage and Dec 8 for the main event.

issues.title: Paperwork: Challenge Updates review (official rule updates/clarifications)
issues.body: Recurring: check throughout the season; mandatory rechecks Nov 5 (pre-scrimmage) and Dec 1 (pre-main-event) — updates supersede the Rulebook for later events.

issues.title: Paperwork: Printed Field Setup Guide (4-up color) as table-reset checklist
issues.body: Needed for scrimmage-rehearsal field-reset drills and as the pit/setup reference on event days.

issues.title: Paperwork: Student Participation Certificates printed
issues.body: Source (Multimedia Resources) sets this at season end — awarded at the Dec 15 celebration; the only checklist item allowed past Oct 31 by its source.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Match format drilled: full 2.5-minute autonomous matches on a timer, run best-of
issues.body: Match format drilled: full 2.5-minute autonomous matches on a timer, run best-of-three style (only the best score counts; ties broken by 2nd then 3rd best) — team has run at least four rehearsal meetings of complete timed matches before Nov 8.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Equipment inspection ready: robot + ALL equipment fits within the two launch are
issues.body: Equipment inspection ready: robot + ALL equipment fits within the two launch areas under 12 in (305 mm); one-launch-area packing layout rehearsed for the 20-point inspection bonus; team can identify their self-built M13 keystone species model (bag 20 bricks, counts as equipment) to inspectors.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Pre-match setup window rehearsed to a couple of minutes: distribute loose missio
issues.body: Pre-match setup window rehearsed to a couple of minutes: distribute loose mission models and equipment between the two home areas, place robot in the chosen launch area, calibrate sensors on the mat, choose M13/M14/M15 dock placement (mine/city/farm), and ask the referee to check the field BEFORE the match.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Technician discipline fixed: two technicians per home area, left/right groups lo
issues.body: Technician discipline fixed: two technicians per home area, left/right groups locked with no side switching (same-side swaps only), everyone else standing back; handling of robot/equipment only when completely within your own home area.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Precision-token rules internalized: six tokens (50 pts) to start; one lost per i
issues.body: Precision-token rules internalized: six tokens (50 pts) to start; one lost per interruption outside home; end-of-match values 1=10/2=15/3=25/4=35/5=50/6=50; the free final stop-in-place exception; relaunch rules (partly outside = same home area, completely outside = either).

issues.title: Scrimmage: High-cost rules mastered via recurring quizzes: M04 katydid even partly outside
issues.body: High-cost rules mastered via recurring quizzes: M04 katydid even partly outside the leaf habitat = zero for the mission; no separating Dual Lock or breaking mission models; robot/model combinations must free in one motion in perfect condition; objects obtained outside home after the last launch go to the referee; points scored by hand outside home don't count.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Variability-proofed programs: M13-15 mission programs work in all three dock ass
issues.body: Variability-proofed programs: M13-15 mission programs work in all three dock assignments; runs don't depend on M04 katydid/leaf placement (referee randomizes every match) or a fixed M02 tube orientation; robot launches from a consistent, noted position and the whole robot fits inside the launch area.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Mission strategy + contingency locked: program run order decided, mission owners
issues.body: Mission strategy + contingency locked: program run order decided, mission owners and robot operators assigned, attachments in labeled per-mission bags and easy to grab, alternate-mission contingency plan for mid-match failures rehearsed.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Scoring fluency: every practice match scored with the official scoresheet / Offi
issues.body: Scoring fluency: every practice match scored with the official scoresheet / Official Scoring Calculator so scrimmage scores are interpretable; team knows post-match review procedure (referee documents results WITH the team; agreement makes it official; head referee is final).

issues.title: Scrimmage: Field ownership: team can reset the full field to wireframe-exact starting state
issues.body: Field ownership: team can reset the full field to wireframe-exact starting state quickly using the printed Field Setup Guide, and knows to check the tournament field and alert the referee to problems (including missing decorative elements) before each match.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Gracious Professionalism ready: team knows referees score GP at EVERY match (2/3
issues.body: Gracious Professionalism ready: team knows referees score GP at EVERY match (2/3/4, default 3, added to the Core Values score), including how to earn it even if the robot breaks; Coopetition behaviors prepared, including the cooperative M07/M05 cross-table bonus.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Judging session ready in case the scrimmage offers judging: 5-minute innovation
issues.body: Judging session ready in case the scrimmage offers judging: 5-minute innovation project presentation and 5-minute robot design explanation (delivered without the field) rehearsed timed per the judging session flowchart, every member with a part and every member's contribution described, prototype/visuals/scripts packed, rubric criteria (including those feeding Core Values) reviewed.

issues.title: Scrimmage: Logistics packed: backed-up programs, charged/updated controller, spare batterie
issues.body: Logistics packed: backed-up programs, charged/updated controller, spare batteries or charged power pack, microSD, one sheet of program-notes paper per home area, scoresheets/calculator, printed Field Setup Guide, and the full packing checklist executed on Nov 5; latest Challenge Updates read and strategy re-verified against them.
